Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve — our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen. Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you. Player-coach: You fly high and low. You understand the strategy while staying close to the details that matter. You roll up your sleeves, stay hands-on, and empower others without micromanaging. Business problem solver: You’re not just a functional expert;
you approach your workthrough the lens of solving business problems. Key Responsibilities Backend Architecture & Development Design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems using .NET and C#. Architect robust APIs, services, and application infrastructure that support current and future products. Establish engineering standards, best practices, and maintainable system architectures. Drive technical decisions that improve scalability, reliability, security, and performance. Full-Stack Development Collaborate with frontend teams working in React to deliver end-to-end application functionality. Contribute across the full stack when needed while maintaining a strong backend focus. Ensure seamless integration between frontend experiences and backend services. Support application modernization and continuous improvement initiatives. AI & Generative AI Integration Design and implement Generative AI solutions within production applications. Evaluate and integrate LLM-powered capabilities that improve business processes and operational efficiency. Build AI-enabled workflows, automation systems, and intelligent application features. Stay current with emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to create business value. Technical Leadership & Solution Design Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership across projects. Make informed technology decisions in environments with evolving requirements and limited structure. Lead solution design discussions and identify the best approaches for implementation. Drive engineering excellence through mentorship, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Collaboration & Delivery Work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Partner with leadership to align technical strategy with business goals. Participate in planning, estimation, prioritization, and delivery activities. Ensure solutions are delivered with high quality and maintainability. Qualifications & Competencies Experience 8+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on backend development. Extensive hands-on experience with .NET and C#. Strong full-stack development experience with modern web application architectures. Experience building and deploying production-grade applications. Experience working in startup, scale-up, or high-growth environments. AI & Modern Engineering Proven experience integrating Generative AI solutions into production applications. Hands-on experience working with LLMs, AI-powered workflows, or intelligent automation systems. Understanding of AI orchestration patterns, agentic workflows, or AI application architecture. Experience evaluating and implementing emerging AI technologies. Technical Expertise Strong knowledge of software architecture, system design, APIs, and distributed systems. Experience designing scalable and maintainable backend services. Deep understanding of modern development practices, testing strategies, and deployment workflows. Strong problem-solving and debugging capabilities. Leadership & Communication Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills. Ability to operate independently and make high-impact technical decisions. Comfortable navigating ambiguity and changing priorities. Strong ownership mentality and accountability for outcomes. Nice to Have Experience with Claude and AI orchestration frameworks. Experience with AI agents, RAG architectures, or advanced LLM implementation patterns. Experience building products or platforms from scratch. Experience leading technical teams or serving as a technical lead. Experience working in highly autonomous engineering environments. What We’re Looking For We're looking for someone who is more than a software developer. The ideal candidate is a senior engineer who can own technical outcomes, architect scalable solutions, integrate AI into real-world products, and operate with minimal oversight. You should be comfortable making architectural decisions, solving complex backend challenges, collaborating across functions, and leveraging AI technologies to create business impact. This role is best suited for someone who is highly autonomous, technically strong, product-minded, and excited about building the future of AI-enabled software systems. Role Details Location : Remote (LATAM / Americas) Time Zone : Must maintain a minimum of 6 hours overlap with US working hours Contract Type : Contracting Duration : 12 Months Expected Start Date : 22 June 2026 Assessment Path : .NET Required Technologies : .NET, C#, React, TypeScript, Generative AI Apply Now Apply now to join Andela's global talent network and support the development of next-generation AI-powered applications for a fast-growing technology-driven organization. This is an excellent opportunity for a Senior Software Engineer, Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Lead Software Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Backend Engineer who enjoys modern architecture, AI-powered development, technical leadership, and building scalable systems from the ground up.

Garantir a organização, fluidez e eficiência da operação da Alter, atuando como elo entre clientes, equipe e lideranças. A profissional será responsável por coordenar cronogramas, distribuir demandas, acompanhar entregas, monitorar prazos e apoiar o atendimento aos clientes, assegurando qualidade, produtividade e alinhamento entre todas as áreas envolvidas.

Principais responsabilidades

Gestão de Projetos e Operações

  • Elaborar, atualizar e monitorar cronogramas de projetos.
  • Estruturar planos de trabalho e fluxos de execução.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de prazos e entregas.
  • Identificar gargalos, riscos e desvios de cronograma.
  • Apoiar lideranças na priorização de demandas.
  • Coordenar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.

Tráfego Interno

  • Distribuir atividades entre as equipes de conteúdo, imprensa, design, audiovisual e marketing.
  • Controlar capacidade produtiva e ocupação da equipe.
  • Acompanhar status de execução das tarefas.
  • Cobrar atualizações e garantir visibilidade sobre o andamento dos projetos.
  • Apoiar o planejamento de férias, ausências e remanejamento de recursos.

Atendimento e Relacionamento com Clientes

  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento.
  • Registrar e organizar demandas dos clientes.
  • Produzir atas, encaminhamentos e planos de ação.
  • Realizar acompanhamento cotidiano dos projetos.
  • Garantir que expectativas, escopo e cronogramas estejam alinhados entre cliente e equipe.

Processos e Melhoria Contínua

  • Apoiar a implementação e evolução de processos internos.
  • Alimentar ferramentas de gestão.
  • Produzir relatórios de acompanhamento.
  • Sugerir melhorias operacionais.
  • Contribuir para a padronização de fluxos, documentos e rotinas.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Formação em Comunicação, Administração, Marketing, Relações Públicas, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em agências de comunicação, marketing ou consultorias.
  • Vivência em gestão de projetos e atendimento.
  • Excelente organização e capacidade de planejamento.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos.

Conhecimento obrigatório em:

  • Trello
  • ClickUp
  • Google Workspace
  • Excel ou Google Sheets


Diferenciais

  • Certificação em metodologias ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de capacidade produtiva (HH).
  • Experiência em projetos de comunicação corporativa.
  • Vivência com clientes de sustentabilidade, terceiro setor ou organismos internacionais.
  • Conhecimento básico de CRM.
  • Familiaridade com Inteligência Artificial aplicada à produtividade e gestão, ESPECIALMENTE CLAUDE.


Competências comportamentais

Organização extrema

Consegue administrar simultaneamente dezenas de entregas, projetos e interlocutores sem perder controle de prioridades.

Capacidade de coordenação

Tem habilidade para mobilizar pessoas, cobrar retornos e manter os projetos em movimento sem gerar ruídos desnecessários.

Comunicação clara

Consegue traduzir demandas, alinhar expectativas e facilitar a comunicação entre diferentes áreas.

Senso de urgência

Entende a diferença entre o que é importante, urgente e estratégico.

Proatividade

Antecipar problemas é mais importante do que reagir a eles.

Inteligência relacional

Lida bem com clientes, equipes multidisciplinares e diferentes estilos de trabalho.


Indicadores de desempenho

  • Percentual de entregas realizadas dentro do prazo.
  • Taxa de retrabalho.
  • Cumprimento dos cronogramas dos projetos.
  • Satisfação dos clientes.
  • Nível de ocupação e distribuição equilibrada da equipe.
  • Tempo médio de resposta às demandas.
  • Qualidade dos registros, atas e controles operacionais.
  • Redução de gargalos e atrasos recorrentes.

title: Talent Data Analyst - Remote
description:

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Talent Data Analyst to join our Talent team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data from our Talent team, extract insights, and help solve problems.

- Understand the Talent funnel and architect a Data solution from scratch, including the definition of KPIs and metrics.

description:

We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us? About you: This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces. Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

description:

We're based in Stockholm and San Francisco and backed by some of the most Some of the most prominent investors in the world. Less then a year we have seen massive growth where we can't keep up with the demand and need engineers to bring the product faster to the market. What you'll be responsible for Building and maintaining production-grade services across our Laravel monolith and Google Cloud Functions layer Shipping merchant-facing React surfaces that turn complex logistics workflows into something a brand operator actually wants to use Owning carrier, warehouse, and shop-system integrations end to end, from the first webhook to long-term reliability Driving performance, cost, and reliability improvements through experiments, profiling, and pragmatic refactoring Enabling the broader team with primitives, tooling, and shared infrastructure that make the next feature faster to build Your hard skillset 5+ years of professional engineering experience overall Strong experience in one backend language (PHP, Ruby, Python, Go, or Rust) with genuine willingness to go deep on PHP/Laravel OR strong experience in React Comfortable across the stack: backend services, frontend, message queues, caches, search, infrastructure as code Experience at product-focused startups using modern tooling and processes Bonus: Shopify, multi-carrier shipping APIs, or e-commerce logistics experience Bigger bonus: you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it Even bigger bonus: you've integrated LLMs or agentic workflows into production, not just a demo Your soft skillset Comfortable being uncomfortable, making calls with incomplete data, and changing your mind when the data changes Empathetic and curious. You build for the merchant, not for the benchmark Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and go-to-market. No lone wolves Detail-oriented but pragmatic. You know when accuracy matters and when to ship You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it Growth and levels We operate on a transparent leveling framework. Each level reflects increasing ownership, impact, and scope, with real jumps in salary and equity. Promotions are based on output, not tenure. This isn't a comfy engineering role. It's fast, focused, and merchant-obsessed. You will launch fast. You will learn fast. You will own what you ship. The process Intro call with the founders (30 minutes) Technical walkthrough and async take-home task (approximately 60 minutes) Final round with the team (half day, on-site if possible) By the end, you'll be wanting access to the stack before your first day, because you'll see exactly what kind of company we're building, and exactly how fast your career can move inside it.

challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours What’s in it for you This description:

About the Product Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI. We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI. Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow. The Team At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design. We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record. About You You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts. Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges. You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build. About the Role Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into. A day’s work may include: Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems) Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture Tech Langs: Python / TS Infra: Nix, AWS Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals) What we’re looking for Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours What’s in it for you This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly. We offer We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule). Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Fully remote. As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply. At YipitData, we value ownership and impact. Your growth is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with regular opportunities for compensation increases and promotions. See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current data team members love working here! As a Data Associate, you will: Own high-impact data products end-to-end — driving product success by delivering best-in-class outputs with a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency. You’ll ramp quickly into full ownership of your products and workflows, operating with minimal oversight. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies and datasets we analyze. You’ll develop deep expertise in our proprietary methods and techniques, building strong mental models that allow you to ensure data accuracy, identify methodology gaps, and derive key insights. Tackle complex data problems independently, using strong analytical judgment to refine methodologies, test new datasets, and solve challenges that require innovative thinking — even when information is incomplete or ambiguous. You’ll standardize best practices and build repeatable processes, always maintaining a high bar for correctness and quality while validating AI-generated outputs. Collaborate cross-functionally with Research, Engineering, and other teams — coordinating across functions to unblock work, align on best practices, and develop technical solutions that streamline workflows, optimize data processes, and push the boundaries of automation. Identify and drive improvements to products and data pipelines, contributing ideas for new products, enhancements, and features. This could include developing new methodologies, exploring and scaling the use of new third-party datasets, or improving product profitability — all with a clear understanding of what drives value for clients. You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have 4–5+ years of experience in data, business, or predictive analytics and are proficient in SQL, Python, and PySpark You have a proven track record of quickly learning new concepts, particularly complex data methodologies, and building strong mental models of how and why data works You actively use AI tools (e.G., ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate your work and are excited about using AI to drive leverage — not just productivity, but fundamentally better and faster ways of working You can clearly communicate complex concepts — including methodology, risks, and tradeoffs — both orally and in writing You have a strong ownership mentality and are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company You can manage multiple projects simultaneously, independently prioritize tasks, and make sound decisions with incomplete information You have experience using sample or panel data to make precise estimates that guide decision-making You have a background in financial markets or are interested in learning more about data-driven investing You have an Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher) For You: Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Flexible work schedule Personal laptop Health and wellness package Remote work We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours What’s in it for you This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. title: Remote Ai Quality Analyst (Chinese)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Ai Quality Analyst (Chinese) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Role Overview: As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Key Qualifications: Chinese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Chinese with a high degree of comp, as Chinese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied. Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic\ "overnarrating\". Rigorouslyevaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying\ "Debug Info\" from the modelto confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience: BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.G., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week) Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 3 months After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Founding Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description Pango is building an agentic operating system for e-commerce logistics, unifying shipping, tracking, returns, and warehouse workflows into one platform powered by AI agents. We're based in Stockholm and San Francisco and backed by some of the most Some of the most prominent investors in the world. Less then a year we have seen massive growth where we can't keep up with the demand and need engineers to bring the product faster to the market. What you'll be responsible for Building and maintaining production-grade services across our Laravel monolith and Google Cloud Functions layer Shipping merchant-facing React surfaces that turn complex logistics workflows into something a brand operator actually wants to use Owning carrier, warehouse, and shop-system integrations end to end, from the first webhook to long-term reliability Driving performance, cost, and reliability improvements through experiments, profiling, and pragmatic refactoring Enabling the broader team with primitives, tooling, and shared infrastructure that make the next feature faster to build Your hard skillset 5+ years of professional engineering experience overall Strong experience in one backend language (PHP, Ruby, Python, Go, or Rust) with genuine willingness to go deep on PHP/Laravel OR strong experience in React Comfortable across the stack: backend services, frontend, message queues, caches, search, infrastructure as code Experience at product-focused startups using modern tooling and processes Bonus: Shopify, multi-carrier shipping APIs, or e-commerce logistics experience Bigger bonus: you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it Even bigger bonus: you've integrated LLMs or agentic workflows into production, not just a demo Your soft skillset Comfortable being uncomfortable, making calls with incomplete data, and changing your mind when the data changes Empathetic and curious. You build for the merchant, not for the benchmark Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and go-to-market. No lone wolves Detail-oriented but pragmatic. You know when accuracy matters and when to ship You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it Growth and levels We operate on a transparent leveling framework. Each level reflects increasing ownership, impact, and scope, with real jumps in salary and equity. Promotions are based on output, not tenure. This isn't a comfy engineering role. It's fast, focused, and merchant-obsessed. You will launch fast. You will learn fast. You will own what you ship. The process Intro call with the founders (30 minutes) Technical walkthrough and async take-home task (approximately 60 minutes) Final round with the team (half day, on-site if possible) By the end, you'll be wanting access to the stack before your first day, because you'll see exactly what kind of company we're building, and exactly how fast your career can move inside it.

We're based in Stockholm and San Francisco and backed by some of the most Some of the most prominent investors in the world. Less then a year we have seen massive growth where we can't keep up with the demand and need engineers to bring the product faster to the market. What you'll be responsible for Building and maintaining production-grade services across our Laravel monolith and Google Cloud Functions layer Shipping merchant-facing React surfaces that turn complex logistics workflows into something a brand operator actually wants to use Owning carrier, warehouse, and shop-system integrations end to end, from the first webhook to long-term reliability Driving performance, cost, and reliability improvements through experiments, profiling, and pragmatic refactoring Enabling the broader team with primitives, tooling, and shared infrastructure that make the next feature faster to build Your hard skillset 5+ years of professional engineering experience overall Strong experience in one backend language (PHP, Ruby, Python, Go, or Rust) with genuine willingness to go deep on PHP/Laravel OR strong experience in React Comfortable across the stack: backend services, frontend, message queues, caches, search, infrastructure as code Experience at product-focused startups using modern tooling and processes Bonus: Shopify, multi-carrier shipping APIs, or e-commerce logistics experience Bigger bonus: you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it Even bigger bonus: you've integrated LLMs or agentic workflows into production, not just a demo Your soft skillset Comfortable being uncomfortable, making calls with incomplete data, and changing your mind when the data changes Empathetic and curious. You know when accuracy matters and when to ship You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it Growth and levels We operate on a transparent leveling framework. It's fast, focused, and merchant-obsessed. You will launch fast. You will learn fast. You will own what you ship. The process Intro call with the founders (30 minutes) Technical walkthrough and async take-home task (approximately 60 minutes) Final round with the team (half day, on-site if possible) By the end, you'll be wanting access to the stack before your first day, because you'll see exactly what kind of company we're building, and exactly how fast your career can move inside it.

title: Remote Ai Quality Analyst (Chinese)
description:

About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L. Role Overview: As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Key Qualifications: Chinese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Chinese with a high degree of comp, as Chinese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied. Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic\ "overnarrating\". Rigorouslyevaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying\ "Debug Info\" from the modelto confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience: BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.G., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week) Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 3 months After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Business Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.


1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.



2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal


.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces


s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.G., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci


es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir


ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.G., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni

ties.

Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Esta oportunidade irá atender uma multinacional líder global no segmento de bens de consumo e transformação digital, em um projeto estratégico de implementação de sistema de folha de pagamento para países da América Latina.

A iniciativa contempla Peru, Colômbia, Equador, Argentina e Chile, envolvendo stakeholders locais e globais das áreas de RH, Payroll, TI, Financeiro, Jurídico e fornecedores de tecnologia .

Trata-se de um projeto de alta visibilidade, em ambiente multicultural e dinâmico, que exige forte governança, gestão de mudanças e alinhamento entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia.

About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We’re looking for a Product Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

  • Helping scope and launch new verticals for the company
  • Defining initial product proposition and go-to-market strategies for new expansion markets

What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university

  • Great problem-solving skills
  • A focus on customer-centric designs and solutions

Nice to have

  • A track record of building successful products (ideally financial) using data, customer feedback, common sense, and/or machine learning

Compensation range

  • Krakow: PLN19,500 - PLN21,600 gross monthly*
  • Poland: PLN19,500 - PLN21,600 gross monthly*
  • Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process

*Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

- Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Fx Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fx Trader em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Remote Ai Quality Analyst (German)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Ai Quality Analyst (German) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • German Proficiency: Ability to read and write in German with a high degree of comp, as German is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.G., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and upto 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months
  • Our offered rate for this project is $15 per hour.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Freelancer | Aem Content Author (Adobe Experience Manager)

  • Conhecimento emestrutura de páginas, templates e componentes no AEM;

  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise como Google Analytics 4 (GA4) e Google Tag Manager (GTM);

title: Video Creator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Creator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Video Creator / Creative Editor

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Contract

Compensation: Retainer that reflects experience, seniority and skill level, + bonuses.

Required Assessment:

───────────────────────────────

916 Studios is a premium creative production company producing social-first content for brands, creators, agencies, and public companies. Our clients range from fast-scaling consumer brands to publicly listed companies, with projects including work for Google, Oracle and TikTok.

───────────────────────────────

THE ROLE:

We're looking for a multi-disciplinary Video Creator / Creative Editor who doesn’t wait to be told that something ‘could be better’.

Video Creators produce high-performance content for social media, website and beyond, blending strategy, editing, motion, sound, and narrative into media that drives results, (not just views).

───────────────────────────────

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Edit premium short & long-form content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube,, and X
  • Own projects end-to-end, from brief to final delivery
  • Act as your own creative director, i.E. source, create, or generate every asset if needed, including: graphics, motion, sound, etc, to cohesively serve the story
  • Build engaging hooks, retention and pacing
  • Adapt creative styles intelligently to different brands and audiences
  • Deliver strong first drafts

───────────────────────────────

COMPLETE THE ASSESSMENT AND APPLY IF YOU HAVE:

  • 5+ years of professional editing experience
  • A portfolio of social-first content that proves viewer-retention with links to work currently live on social media
  • Advanced Premiere Pro + working After Effects so that you can build from scratch, (not reliant on templates)
  • A strong sense of storytelling, with the ability to independently select and organise footage into a coherent, engaging narrative even without a provided script
  • The ability to work efficiently under pressure and at speed without compromising quality
  • Strong sense for design, photo editing, and branding
  • A strong sound design, colour grading, and audio mixing ability
  • A deep understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and platform-native editing
  • Clean workflow habits: methodical, organised, no missed deadlines and excellent communication.

───────────────────────────────

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

  • You consistently deliver high-quality edits with meticulous attention to detail
  • Your first cuts are robust and require minimal revision (if any!)
  • You actively look for ways to improve content without being asked
  • You anticipate roadblocks and resolve issues independently before escalating
  • You meet deadlines consistently and flag potential delays early
  • You bring fresh ideas, formats, and techniques to every project

───────────────────────────────

WHY JOIN US:

  1. 100% remote, flexible working
  2. Full creative ownership from day one without micromanagement
  3. International brands and creator campaigns
  4. Performance bonuses + genuine path to a core creative role
  5. Upskilling with AI workflows and content systems

───────────────────────────────

HOW TO APPLY:

  1. Complete the required creative assessment first:
  2. Include your portfolio, CV, and a 2–4 sentence cover note.
  • IMPORTANT: Applications without a completed assessment will not be considered.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa assistente de incidentes & dados de frota em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a oportunidade

Você não será apenas uma pessoa que observa veículos no mapa. Na INFLEET, a Pessoa Assistente de Incidentes & Dados é peça-chave na segurança e eficiência das operações dos nossos clientes. Seu papel é transformar ocorrências em dados e agir com agilidade quando o imprevisto acontece.
Se você tem um olhar analítico, gosta de resolver problemas em tempo real e entende que cada dado conta uma história, essa vaga é para você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gestão de Incidentes: Atuar proativamente na identificação e resposta a alertas e incidentes críticos das frotas em tempo real;
  • Análise de Dados: Transformar os registros de monitoramento em relatórios analíticos, identificando padrões de comportamento e pontos de melhoria para o cliente;
  • Interface com o Cliente: Ser o ponto de contato consultivo para reportar ocorrências graves e dar suporte na resolução de problemas;
  • Monitoramento Estratégico: Utilizar nossa tecnologia para garantir que as regras de segurança e logística estejam sendo cumpridas;

Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de marketplace | lauro de freitas em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

- Desejável ensino superior completo;

- Ter disponibilidade para trabalhar 44 horas semanais

- Ter experiência na área por no mínimo 6 meses;

- Capacidade de delegar;

- Saber trabalhar em equipe;

- Conhecimento do Pacote Office;

- E por último e muito importante, é ter paixão pelo o que faz;


E aí? Pronto para fazer parte do nosso time?

O que um(a) Gerente de Marketplace faz na Bel Cosméticos? Se liga aí:


  • Gerenciar a operação de vendas nos principais marketplaces, equilibrando estratégias de preço com a performance técnica das plataformas para garantir o crescimento do canal.
  • Dominar os algoritmos de busca e gerenciar as ferramentas de anúncios internos (Retail Media/Ads) de canais como Mercado Livre e Amazon Brasil, otimizando o posicionamento dos produtos.
  • Monitorar e analisar constantemente os indicadores de performance do negócio, incluindo taxa de conversão, Custo de Aquisição de Clientes (CAC), margem de lucro líquido e giro de estoque, embasando as tomadas de decisão.
  • Coordenar os processos de fulfillment (armazenamento e entrega), realizar o controle rigoroso de prazos e gerenciar o estoque para mitigar o risco de rupturas.
  • Monitorar e garantir a manutenção de altas métricas de atendimento e a reputação das lojas dentro das plataformas, evitando bloqueios e assegurando a confiança do comprador.
  • Formular e executar estratégias de preços competitivos utilizando ferramentas de precificação dinâmica, com foco em maximizar as vendas sem comprometer a rentabilidade do negócio.

title: Pessoa coordenadora de campo - salvador /ba
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa coordenadora de campo - salvador /ba em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.
  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Experiência com Gestão de Pessoas;
  • Desejável experiência com Venda Direta e atuação em campo;
  • Possuir CNH e Veículo Próprio.


  • Prospecção de novos cadastros em campo, centrado na gestão da equipe de entradas e na otimização dos processos de atração de novas revendedoras.
  • Supervisionar a equipe de promotores, cuja atividade central é prospectar, ir a campo e ligar para a listagem para trazer novas revendedores.
  • Planejamento de Roteirização e Campo: Orientar os promotores no planejamento semanal de suas atividades, incentivando a prospecção direta (porta-a porta).
  • Utilizar ferramentas como o Plano de Expansão Bairro a Bairro (PEB) para identificar e priorizar áreas com alto potencial de cobertura e gap, ajudando os promotores a direcionar a estratégia de prospecção com base na análise de personas e localização.
  • Gestão e Controle de Cadastros Alocação de Cadastros Online Gerenciar o novo processo de alocação em massa dos cadastros online, que são distribuídos de forma igualitária aos promotores.
  • Assegurar que os cadastros realizados offline pelos promotores caiam diretamente para eles na estrutura.

title: Técnico de suporte de 2º nível
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Técnico de suporte de 2º nível em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Formação Acadêmica:

Ensino médio completo ou curso técnico equivalente, comprovado por certificado expedido por instituição de ensino reconhecida pelo Ministério da Educação.


Certificações/Cursos:

Certificação Microsoft MD-100: Windows 10 MD - 102 ou equivalentes;

Desejável ISSABEL ATERISK Versão13.30 ou superior;

Desejável Curso de montagem, manutenção e configuração de computadores, com carga horária mínima de 60 horas.


Experiência Profissional:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à suporte local e remoto via ferramenta de conexão remota (instalação, configuração e manutenção) em sistemas operacionais Windows 7, 8, 10 ou superior, Microsoft Office versões 2016 e 365 ou superior, e softwares necessários para o desenvolvimento das atividades laborais, em manutenção de microcomputadores.

· Efetuar a substituição e remanejamento de módulos e equipamentos conforme demanda e planejamento prévio;

· Substituir itens de suprimentos e manutenção de equipamentos em geral (microcomputadores, impressoras laser, por exemplo);

· Realizar pequenos reparos em componentes de serviços disponibilizados aos usuários (equipamentos, sistemas, documentação técnica/normativa etc.);

· Instalar e configurar softwares em microcomputadores e dispositivos móveis de usuários;

· Elaborar scripts e packages ou instalação de softwares.

· Efetuar a geração e aplicação de imagens de computadores;

· Efetuar a ativação, testes e desativação de pontos de rede e equipamentos de TI em geral;

· Executar serviços de cabeamento de rede tipo par trançado 10/100 mbps obedecendo ao padrão de conectorização já adotado;

· Efetuar a execução e restauração de back-up e procedimentos periódicos de rotina;

· Efetuar a elaboração de instruções de configuração e de operação de equipamentos e Softwares;

· Realizar contatos com os usuários para obtenção de detalhes adicionais a respeito das solicitações não disponibilizadas no primeiro contato, na tentativa de solucionar o problema;

· Prestar orientações e dicas quanto ao uso de funcionalidades e facilidades disponíveis nos softwares básicos, aplicativos, sistemas de informações e equipamentos em geral;

· Realizar instalação e configuração de impressoras através do protocolo TCP/IP;

· Acompanhamento de fornecedores de TI diversos através de tickets, e-mail, telefone e reuniões presenciais;

· Controle de inventário de ativos;

· Suporte à telefonia fixa móvel;

· Documentar atividades desempenhadas;

· Esclarecer dúvidas de clientes sobre configuração, instalação, funcionamento e manutenção de equipamentos e componentes de informática;

· Executar outras tarefas correlatas.

title: Gerenciador (gbarbosa) - salvador/ba
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerenciador (gbarbosa) - salvador/ba em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Formação: Ensino Médio completo ou Superior em andamento;

Habilidade em informática (pacote office);

Vivência no segmento de varejo (supermercados, lojas de departamentos) na área de atendimento;

Experiência na gestão de pessoas e desenvolvimento de equipes;

Vivência na gestão e controle de indicadores de desempenho operacional e financeiro.


Liderança, boa comunicação, orientação para resultados, tino comercial, organização e proatividade complementam o perfil buscado.

O QUE VOCÊ TERÁ DE RESPONSABILIDADES


Acompanhar as atividades diárias do setor de atuação, visando o atendimento com excelência aos clientes e colaboradores;

Acompanhar as vendas e os processos operacionais objetivando alcançar as metas estabelecidas do setor;

Acompanhar o suprimento de produtos para venda e consumo, buscando ativar uma melhor circulação do estoque;

Acompanhar o abastecimento, limpeza, organização, controle de estoque, rupturas e pedidos de mercadorias;

Gerir e executar corretamente os processos de segurança para prevenir ao máximo as perdas;

Liderar e desenvolver os colaboradores auxiliando na sua função técnico/ profissional visando o aprimoramento das suas atividades;

Realizar gestão de desempenho acompanhando e apoiando os colaboradores, realizando feedback estruturado;

Acompanhar, analisar, tratar e executar ações para garantir o cumprimento e metas dos indicadores de resultado do negócio (vendas, margem, quebras, despesas, DDE (Dias de Estoque), Resultado de Inventário, etc;

Implantar, cumprir e manter programas/projetos implantados na empresa;

Planejar e executar processos operacionais do setor. Ex.: gestão de horas, escalas, férias, orgânico, treinamentos, reuniões, distribuição de atividades, verificar e acompanhar a limpeza do setor e equipamentos.

title: Almoxarife operador ii
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Almoxarife operador ii em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • CNH Carteira de Habilitação Nacional;
  • Certificado de NR 11;
  • Experiência na área de logística, almoxarifado;
  • Conhecimento básico do Pacote Office.
  • Realizar as atividades de carga e descarga de materiais dos caminhões, conferindo sua entrada e saída conforme nota fiscal;
  • Recepcionar, armazenar e movimentar materiais com o auxílio de equipamentos que não requeiram cursos específicos para seu manuseio como paleteiras manuais, carros plataforma de movimentação e equipamentos que requeiram curso específico para seu manuseio como empilhadeiras, ponte rolante apoiada, paleteiras elétricas, entre outros;
  • Executar tarefas de estocagem, arrumação, preservação e limpeza de materiais e do almoxarifado;
  • Atender os clientes no balcão do almoxarifado, recebendo as requisições e entregando os materiais solicitados;
  • Realizar o levantamento dos inventários realizando a contagem física para assegurar a conformidade dos itens do estoque;
  • Emitir nota fiscal de saída de materiais;
  • Separar materiais para devolução, encaminhando a documentação para os procedimentos necessários;
  • Verificar itens vencidos, acompanhar prazos de vencimento e divulgar a data de validade quando estiver próximo de ser expirada para o almoxarife;
  • Realizar baixa de atendimento de materiais no sistema;
  • Controlar o recebimento e conferência dos materiais entregues pelos fornecedores;
  • Organizar a estocagem dos materiais em seus devidos locais de armazenamento;
  • Receber, emitir e arquivar documentos de movimentação de materiais;
  • Fazer o checklist de inspeção, operação e manutenção de equipamentos;                                                      
  • Emitir requisições de materiais através da verificação dos registros de entrada e saída de materiais;
  • Receber os insumos devolvidos de modo a realizar a conferência das desconformidades desses itens, a fim de atender a real necessidade dos requisitantes com qualidade e agilidade;
  • Manter atualizado os sistemas informatizados de gestão de materiais com os lançamentos de entrada e saída de materiais.
  • Orientar/treinar os almoxarifes operadores no desempenho de suas atividades.

title: Banco de talentos - grupo gvc
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Banco de talentos - grupo gvc em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.


Empresa: O Grupo GVC é o alicerce de uma jornada transformadora rumo à sustentabilidade e segurança ambiental. Com um compromisso inabalável com o planeta, através do conhecimento especializado e tecnologias inovadoras, o Grupo GVC se dedica a preservar o meio ambiente e proteger as comunidades, garantindo que os resíduos sejam gerenciados com responsabilidade e em conformidade com os mais rigorosos padrões de segurança. Nossa missão é impactar gerações com soluções socioambientais sustentáveis para um mundo melhor.


O Banco de Talentos do Grupo GVC visa identificar e selecionar profissionais que compartilhem do comprometimento com a sustentabilidade e a segurança ambiental. Os talentos serão integrados em projetos e iniciativas que buscam soluções inovadoras para a gestão de resíduos, colaborando para a missão de promover um mundo melhor e sustentável.

title: Aux. de rh
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Aux. de rh em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Executa tarefas administrativas relacionadas à admissão, demissão, controle de ponto, benefícios e demais obrigações legais, garantindo conformidade com a legislação trabalhista e políticas internas da empresa.

  • Atender colaboradores para dúvidas, declarações e suporte básico.

title: Consultor(a) de vendas de veículos seminovos (jetour) - salvador/ba (1)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor(a) de vendas de veículos seminovos (jetour) - salvador/ba (1) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Se você:


  • Possui o ensino médio Completo;
  • Possui CNH categoria B Ativa;
  • Possui noções de Informática e em Sistemas de Gestão de Vendas e CRM;
  • Tem experiência com atendimento ao cliente;
  • Tem conhecimento em Matemática Financeira;
  • Tem conhecimento em técnica de vendas e negociação.


O #GrupoNewChase é o seu lugar!


Será considerado um diferencial se você:


  • Tem experiência comercial em concessionárias.
  • Realizar atendimento ao cliente seja no showroom ou no digital/ligação, aplicando a metodologia padrão da montadora, através de uma postura simpática, entusiasmada e cordial com conhecimentos sedimentados dos produtos, identificando as necessidades do cliente e apresentando o mix de produtos e benefícios com o objetivo de garantir o fechamento do negócio e atingir as metas estabelecidas pela Diretoria Comercial.
  • Realizar vendas mensais, equilibrando volume, ISC (Índice de Satisfação do Cliente), lucratividade, acessórios, F&I e serviços, buscando atingir os objetivos do Grupo e os individuais.
  • Identificar as necessidades dos clientes e oferecer soluções adequadas, realizando demonstrações de veículos e test drive, negociando condições de pagamento, preços e prazo de entrega, com isso concretizando a venda e o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas pela Diretoria da área.  
  • Realizar prospecção de novos clientes através de ferramentas digitais e/ou ligações, utilizando redes sociais, e-mails marketing e outras plataformas online para alcançar potenciais clientes e realizando chamadas ativas para leads qualificados, proporcionando um atendimento personalizado e consultivo.  
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências do mercado automotivo e características dos produtos oferecidos, para ser capaz de oferecer as melhores soluções de mobilidade, incluindo uma abordagem proativa na prospecção de novos clientes, através de ferramentas digitais e a prospecção por ligação.  
  • Acompanhar e controlar, diariamente, a sua agenda, através do sistema corporativo de gestão de relacionamento com cliente. 
  • Monitorar o funil de vendas, acompanhando todas as etapas do processo de venda, desde a prospecção inicial até o fechamento. 
  • Analisar os dados do funil de vendas para identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria, ajustando estratégias conforme necessário, segmentando os clientes de acordo com o estágio no funil de vendas, personalizando abordagens e comunicações para maximizar as chances de conversão. 
  • Registrar, diariamente, no sistema corporativo todo histórico dos atendimentos realizados (telefone, e-mail, showroom, recepção, qualificação, apresentação do veículo, test drive, negociação, entrega, gestão de carteira e vendas que não foram efetuadas) com motivos e acompanhamentos, a fim de manter atualização e criar dados para análise de melhorias futuras.
  • Elaborar a proposta de venda, através do sistema corporativo, certificando que o produto esteja em estoque, trânsito e plano mensal, seguindo as orientações internas do departamento, visando fornecer ao cliente informações verídicas da negociação, promovendo sua satisfação e garantindo o resultado esperado pelo setor. 
  • Acompanhar todo o processo da venda (emplacamento, instalação de acessórios, processo de veículo usado quando se aplicar), monitorando os pagamentos efetuados pelos clientes, para garantir o prazo de entrega negociado e preservar total satisfação do cliente. 
  • Inserir todas as propostas e documentos do processo de vendas no sistema de arquivo digital corporativo, contribuindo para o funcionamento correto do departamento, considerando políticas internas do Grupo. 
  • Acompanhar a entrega dos veículos vendidos, garantindo a satisfação do cliente.
  • Representar a concessionária do Grupo NewChase em feiras, eventos e lançamentos de novos produtos, promovendo os veículos e serviços da marca.
  • Monitorar as tendências do mercado automotivo, novas tecnologias e atividades da concorrência, identificando oportunidades de negócio e sugerindo ações para aumentar a competitividade do setor.
  • Realizar os cursos presenciais e via WEB da montadora e do Grupo, através do cronograma de cursos enviado pela Diretoria de Recursos Humanos, a fim de garantir a aprovação e manutenção do índice definido pela montadora.
  • Executar outras tarefas que venham a ser delegadas pelo(a) gestor(a) da área.
